headline: Hyperscalers charge double or more over neoclouds across all six GPUs, peaking at +217% on H100 SXM.
bullets: H100 SXM shows the widest hyperscaler premium at +217%, with a hyperscaler median of $12.12 against a neocloud median of $3.82 and a market index of $3.82.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $1.83 per PFLOP-hour, with a $2.39 market index and a marketplace median as low as $0.50 at RunPod Community Cloud, though only 3 providers list it.
B200 leads the market at a $6.84 index, with neocloud ($6.81) and marketplace ($6.90) medians nearly level while hyperscalers sit at $14.24, a +109% premium.
H200 indexes at $5.00 but costs $5.06 per PFLOP-hour, worse than B200 at $3.04, and A100 80GB SXM is the least efficient at $7.02 despite a $2.19 index.
Marketplace providers undercut neoclouds on most GPUs, with Vast.ai cheapest for H100 SXM at $2.40 and A100 80GB SXM at $1.06.
watch: With only 3 days of history and no 7-day change yet, watch whether the +217% H100 SXM and +214% MI300X hyperscaler premiums hold once a full trend window is available.
